summary: Full QA pass of foundations + auth/onboarding + verification. Backend: 62 of 63 pytest pass. That covers the 4 existing suites (47/47) plus the new test_iter12_e2e_snapshots.py: B2C order snapshot with total = goods + buyer_fee; B2B negotiation to accepted agreement with commercial_snapshot; logistics quote -> select, giving a transport snapshot with producer_fee > 0; a rules change via PUT that leaves the old order snapshot and total unchanged, with rules restored afterwards; 10 permission-matrix 403 checks. Found and FIXED a 500 on GET /api/products?q=( (unescaped regex). Still open: POST /api/orders accepts blank shipping fields and fractional qty. Frontend (375x667), all requested flows PASS: forgot-password link -> success notice; reset-password with a bad token shows an error, but the generic 'Errore 422'; verify-email with a bad token shows the invalid-link notice. New logistics registration lands on /logistics/spedizioni and shows the banner and menu-onboarding. The onboarding draft resumes at step 2 with its data after reload. The ATP checklist item shows only when temperature_controlled is on. Admin verify console: segments and sheet work, reject without a reason and approve with missing docs are both blocked with a message. Rules screen lists versions and publish stays disabled until a reason is typed. Audit rows expand to before/after. Producer declarations work, the verified-badge shows, and checkout-fee shows 'Prodotti €3.90 + mediazione 3% €0.12', total €4.02. Reseller lands on /buyer/mercato with the Trattative tab, and /buyer/piani is an unmatched route. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch). SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

minor.issue: FIXED BY T1: returned 500 (pymongo OperationFailure: invalid regex) because the raw q was used in $regex. Now re.escape(q) in routers/market.py. The same unescaped pattern still exists in routers/regulatory.py (country/category regex f'^{country}$'), lines 144, 222, 365, 485, 537, 539, 577.

OrderIn has no validation on address/city/zip/phone: blank strings are accepted and an order is created. qty accepts fractions (0.5) for piece-priced products. Add min_length and pattern rules for zip/phone. Reference: models.py:229-236.

Reason ('note') is optional server-side (RulesIn.note Optional). Only the UI enforces >=3 chars. The spec says publishing requires a reason, so enforce min_length on the server. Reference: routers/governance.py:46-49.
Package orders neither check nor decrement product stock (only the items path does). Reference: routers/market.py:159-176.
A token shorter than 20 chars returns Pydantic 422 with a list detail, so frontend api.ts shows 'Errore 422' instead of 'Link non valido o scaduto'.
Needs auth (401 anonymous), so the 'public' producer page /shared/producer/<id> and its verified badge cannot be seen by logged-out visitors or shared links. Confirm this is intended.

ui_bugs.issue: A bad or short token shows a generic 'Errore 422' notice instead of a friendly invalid-link message. Fix: map array 'detail' in src/api.ts:75 or special-case 422 on this screen.
No 'Respinte' (rejected) segment. Only pending/draft/approved/suspended exist, so rejected companies are unreachable from the console. Reference: app/(app)/admin/utenti/verifica.tsx:50-52.

issues: Onboarding data is shown as raw keys and values (legal_name:, vat_id:, temperature_controlled: false). Use the schema labels and Sì/No.
Filter chips show raw entity identifiers (business_rules, verification_document, role_permissions). Before/after is a raw JSON dump, so localise and show a diff.
No per-step validation: an invalid VAT, or empty required fields, pass 'Continua' and are saved to the draft. The user only learns at final submit, through a single long toast.
3 stacked amber banners (verify email, complete profile, pending approval) clutter the top of the screen. Consider merging them.
product-add buttons are 32x32 and forgot-password-link is 32px tall, below the 44pt minimum touch target.
Verified badge is left-aligned while the name and location are centred.
Closing date is free text (AAAA-MM-GG) with no picker or format validation hint beyond the placeholder.

Leftover TEST data is visible to real users: 'TEST Box Curatore' package with a broken image in the market, TEST_Shipment in the logistics list, several TEST_Buyer accounts in the admin pending queue, TEST b2b offers. Rules history contains TEST versions v2-v7. These are immutable by design; active v7 has the same values as v1.

react_native_issues.issue: Web console warns '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' (expo log). Minor, web only.

action_items: Add validation to OrderIn: address/city/zip/phone min_length; zip and phone pattern; integer qty where unit is per piece.
Enforce the reason server-side for PUT /api/admin/business-rules (note min_length 3).
Escape the regex input in routers/regulatory.py country/category filters (re.escape).
In src/api.ts, map Pydantic list 'detail' to a readable message. On reset-password, show 'Link non valido o scaduto' for 422.
Add a 'Respinte' (rejected) tab to the admin verification console.
Localise the onboarding fields in the admin company sheet, and the audit entity chips and before/after view.
Add per-step required and pattern validation in the onboarding wizard before 'Continua'.
Package orders: check and decrement stock.
Remove TEST seed leftovers from user-facing lists (TEST Box Curatore package, TEST_Shipment, TEST_Buyer accounts, TEST offers).
Raise the touch targets of product-add (32px) and forgot-password-link (32px) to 44px.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/market.py list_products used the user-provided q directly in $regex, which caused a 500 or ReDoS risk (fixed).
B2B agreements have no GET endpoint exposing commercial_snapshot. It was verified via the DB only. Consider an agreements list for buyer and producer.
select-quote zeroes producer_fee when a non-producer books, which is consistent with the rule. Snapshots are written once, and the conditional update on carrier_id:None makes the booking atomic.
Onboarding save mutation has no onError, so draft save failures are silent.

success_rate.backend: 98% (62/63; the 1 failure is the open order-validation gap)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; minor UX issues listed

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: a TEST order, a TEST_iter12 b2b offer, negotiation and agreement, a TEST_iter12 shipment, and the test_logi_1793177645@example.com user with its tokens and onboarding draft. Business rules were published twice per run (change and restore). Active version is v7, with values identical to v1 (mediated_sale 3/2, introduction 0/2 window 18, transport 0/1, labels 0/1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 1 and export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. test_iter12_e2e_snapshots.py creates and cleans its own data. It publishes 2 rule versions per run and restores the values (versions are immutable, so the version number grows). test_order_rejects_blank_address fails until OrderIn validation is added. /api/products needs auth. Admin console segments are labelled In coda/Bozze/Verificate/Sospese. The onboarding toggle is testID ob-temperature_controlled. Chips are ob-<field>-<option>.
rca_of_issue: Products search 500: q was passed unescaped to MongoDB $regex, so '(' produced 'Regular expression is invalid: missing closing parenthesis' (backend.err.log). Mitigated with re.escape in routers/market.py.
